visibleTextSample: < Changes in your own photos Want your phone to read your own progress for you? It compares your own guided photos over time and describes what changed. In words, never a number or grade. ✓ Runs entirely on your phone. Your own photos comparing your own photos. ✓ No photo or result is ever uploaded. Nothing trains any AI. ✓ No score, no “skin age,” no grade, and you can turn it off anytime. ✦ A separate, distinct, revocable choice, never bundled with anything else. Read my progress Off by default How it stays fair across skin tones › never default-on · installed base is re-consented, never silently enrolled
